agent: EwmAgent (five-pillar world-model agent, FIXED harness: probe-first seeding + repair caps + live pass-rate floor)
model: qwen-coding:latest (qwen35moe 36B, vision-capable, num_ctx 65536, ollama) as BOTH gameplay and synthesis model (single model, no --synth-model)
note_reasoning_effort: ARC_LLM_REASONING_EFFORT=none reused from the qwen35b-arc arm. Pre-run text sanity check confirmed qwen-coding answers directly in message.content with finish_reason=stop (no empty-content thinking drain).
harness: post-fix (probe-first): SYNTHESIZE is only entered after probe seeding builds a non-empty suite (min_probe_transitions=4, one probe per distinct valid action), and adoption requires validate() to PASS on that non-empty suite. Vacuous adoption (arm 3's failure mode) is impossible on this harness.
note_live_pass_rate: VACUOUS 1.0, not a real score. The live pass-rate window (_live_results) only scores observed transitions against an ACTIVE adopted program; no program was ever adopted, so the window stayed empty and _live_pass_rate() returns its empty-window default of 1.0. The pass-rate floor machinery therefore never had anything to trip on.
note_divergences: NOT model divergences. The driver maps 'divergences' from summary.reactive_turns, which counts RECOVER-mode (Duck-style reactive) decide turns. With no program ever adopted there were zero expect-mismatch divergences to count; the 76 is 80 total actions minus the 4 probe-seeding actions -- i.e. 76 reactive fallback turns. (On arm 3 the same field was 80 EXECUTE-mode expect-mismatches against the vacuously adopted program; the field name overloads two different things across adopted/non-adopted runs.)
best_pass_rate: 0/4 synthesis attempts validated (no candidate program ever passed validate() on the seeded non-empty suite, so no adoption and no live pass-rate was ever measured)
note_synthesis: Probe-first machinery worked exactly as designed: 4 probe actions seeded the suite (min_probe_transitions=4), SYNTHESIZE engaged 4 times against a growing suite (final suite_size=80), and ALL 4 candidate programs from qwen-coding FAILED validation against the real observed ls20 transitions -- so the harness correctly REFUSED adoption every time and fell back to reactive play for the remaining 76 turns. repair_attempts=0 because repair only engages on divergence of an adopted program. This is the honest post-fix contrast to arm 3: same 0-level outcome, but no lying world model.
stop_reason: budget (80-action cap hit at ~23.2 min of the 25-min wall cap)
note_multimodality: Pre-run sanity: qwen-coding read the BEFORE|AFTER|DIFF composite via /v1 image_url parts and correctly reported exactly one changed cell and its panel location on a 5x5 composite; on a 3x3 composite its precise (row,col)+color naming was off-by-one -- vision genuinely reaches the model but fine-grained cell indexing is weaker than qwen35b-arc showed in the arm-3 sanity check.
